Connect Outlook

Checking supported connections…

Classic Outlook · direct local read

Reads the default Inbox through installed Classic Outlook. Latest 50 messages within seven days; no mail modifications. Outlook security prompts and policy remain in force.

New Outlook · Microsoft mailbox

Reads the same Microsoft 365 or Outlook.com mailbox through Microsoft Graph. Sign in with the same account you use in Outlook. The installed New Outlook app alone cannot provide local mail access.

I only have Outlook installed—what setup is needed?
  1. Ask your Microsoft 365 administrator to register a public desktop application in Microsoft Entra. Personal accounts need an app registration supporting personal Microsoft accounts.
  2. Enable public-client flows for device-code sign-in and add Microsoft Graph delegated Mail.Read. No client secret, sending, or mail-write permission is needed.
  3. Copy its Application (client) ID below. Sign in at Microsoft and review the requested permission. Organizational policy may require administrator consent or disallow device sign-in.
  4. If app registration is unavailable, pasted-email analysis works immediately. See the included OUTLOOK_SETUP.md guide for the detailed route.

No Microsoft password or access token is entered into this app’s UI.

Inbox only. Graph starts with a seven-day window and tracks changes. Up to 200 messages retained in session memory. Authentication, attachment contents, OCR, and unseen folders are outside coverage.

Data boundaries & AI

Local session

Messages and Microsoft tokens are held in the local process memory. Review state stays in browser memory. Disconnect clears imported mailbox records and the Microsoft token; manual messages remain until reload. Closing the app stops polling. Restarting the service clears server state.

NVIDIA Nemotron · separate permission

Configure NVIDIA_API_KEY on the local server. Each model request requires explicit consent to transmit the selected message. Sensitive HR requests receive an additional notice in that consent. NVIDIA has its own data-handling terms. No model result is fabricated if a key is absent.

Minimized incident packet

Export excludes sender, subject, body, evidence quotes, full URLs, and mailbox IDs. Categories and review times remain, so review before sharing. Checklists are user-entered and not tamper-proof audit evidence.

Advisory message assessment only. No sending, deletion, read-state changes, or employment decisions. False positives and misses are possible. Production requires further evaluation and operational controls.
